messages:
maria_g: Hey team, customer `ClearLedger` opened a support ticket — they're getting sustained 429s in prod during minute boundaries. They say spikes hit at the top of the minute and last ~6–8s. Any quick triage tips?

alex_w: Do we have a request_id or sample logs from their calls? Also which endpoint — /v1/chat or embeddings?

maria_g: Sent request_id rl-20260301-cc1 and attached API logs. It's the chat completions endpoint, mostly streaming clients. Example header we see: `x-rate-limit-retry-after` absent, response body is 429 with meta {"limit_type":"rpm"}.

samir_r: Looking at the logs we got from ClearLedger — bursts are very regular at `00` seconds. Their client runs a cron of 60s and fans out ~120 requests in parallel. That's the classic minute-boundary fanout.

ingrid_s: +1. If they're multiplexing over HTTP/2 or many simultaneous streaming connections we can hit per-minute RPM limits even though average looks ok. Do we know if they use our SDK or custom worker?

maria_g: Custom worker. They say they queue tasks and flush every minute to reduce downstream calls. They thought batching would help but it's creating a spike.

alex_w: Quick mitigations we can recommend: 1) jitter their cron (randomize flush time or spread across the minute), 2) add exponential backoff with jitter for 429s, 3) reduce parallelism when near minute boundaries, 4) consider streaming to 1 connection with multiplexed messages if feasible. Also ask if they can move to Dedicated if sustained throughput needs guarantee.

samir_r: From infra side, I confirmed the throttle windows line up with our RPM counters — traffic from their tenant hits the RPM cap. We can temporarily grant a quota bump for a few hours while they patch.

maria_g: I'll propose a short quota bump and the client fixes. Do we have a playbook message/snippet to share for jittered scheduling?

oncall-bot: Incident suggestion: apply short quota bump (support escalation) OR request customer deploy client-side smoothing. Escalation TTL: 4h.

alex_w: Snippet for jitter (JS):
```
// spread flush across minute
const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000 * 45); // 0-45s
setTimeout(() => flushBatch(), jitter);
```
Also example retry header handling: check `Retry-After` (seconds) and fallback to exponential backoff starting at 500ms + jitter.

maria_g: Shared both with the customer and asked for a deploy ETA. They're going to try jitter + reducing concurrency from 120 -> 8 simultaneous streams. They've asked for the temporary quota bump while they deploy.

samir_r: I put in the internal quota request: +2x RPM for tenant id `tenant-CL-92` for 6 hours. Approvers: @ingrid_s, @alex_w. Please ack.

ingrid_s: Approved for 6 hours while they deploy fix. I also flagged the tenant to monitor for unusual error rates.

maria_g: Customer confirmed deploy started, rolling to prod now. Will monitor. Thanks all.

support-bot: Note: follow up reminder scheduled in 5 hours to verify quota rollback and confirm reduced 429s.

alex_w: FYI for product docs — we should add a short guide on minute-boundary fanout and cron jittering for high-RPM customers. Filing a small docs task after this.

maria_g: Closing loop here once monitoring shows drop in 429s. Leaving thread open for follow-ups.
